# DX-91 Regression Surfaces Inventory

**Task:** `inventory-regression-surfaces`  
**Commit:** `706a201` (main branch)  
**Date:** 2026-03-12

---

## Overview

This document inventories every behavior surface that DX-91 (Invar Simplification) can break before destructive changes begin. It serves as the anchor for all harness work in this phase.

---

## 1. Init/Dev-Sync Outputs (BEHAVIOR SURFACE)

| File | Current Behavior | DX-91 Change | Risk Level |
|------|-----------------|--------------|------------|

| `.invar/context.md` | Project context, task router | **DELETED** (not generated) | **MEDIUM** |
| `.invar/examples/` | Code examples for agents | **DELETED** (not generated) | **MEDIUM** |
| `.claude/skills/` | 8 skill templates | **DELETED** (not generated) | **HIGH** |
| `.claude/hooks/` | PreToolUse, PostToolUse, Stop | **DELETED** (not generated) | **HIGH** |
| `.claude/commands/` | /audit, /guard commands | **DELETED** (not generated) | **MEDIUM** |
| `.pi/hooks/` | Pi-specific hooks | **DELETED** (not generated) | **MEDIUM** |
| `.pi/tools/` | Pi custom tools | **DELETED** (not generated) | **MEDIUM** |
| `.pre-commit-config.yaml` | Full config with multiple hooks | Single `invar guard` hook | **LOW** |
| `.mcp.json` | Auto-generated | **NOT generated** (manual setup) | **LOW** |

## 2. Migration Paths (BEHAVIOR SURFACE)

### 2.1 v1 → v2 Migration Triggers

A project is considered **v1** if ANY of these exist:
- `.claude/skills/` directory
- `.claude/hooks/` directory  
- `.pi/hooks/` directory
- `.pi/tools/` directory
- `.invar/examples/` directory
- `INVAR.md` with v1 managed header comment
- `CLAUDE.md` with `<!--invar:critical-->` or `<!--invar:managed-->` markers

### 2.2 Migration Behavior Changes

| Scenario | Current Behavior | Post-DX-91 Behavior | Risk |
|----------|-----------------|-------------------|------|
| Fresh init (no v1) | Interactive prompts | Non-interactive direct creation | **HIGH** |
| v1 detected | Silent merge | **REQUIRES preview + confirmation** | **HIGH** |
| Re-run init | Appends/replaces | Replaces between single markers | **MEDIUM** |
| Backup failure | N/A | **ABORTS migration** (required) | **HIGH** |

### 2.3 Destructive Cleanup

| Action | Current | Post-DX-91 | Risk |
|--------|---------|------------|------|
| Delete skills | N/A | Delete `.claude/skills/` (if present) | **HIGH** |
| Delete hooks | N/A | Delete `.claude/hooks/` (if present) | **HIGH** |
| Delete examples | N/A | Delete `.invar/examples/` (if present) | **MEDIUM** |
| Preserve user data | N/A | Backup `.invar/context.md` → `.invar/backup/v1-context.md` | **MEDIUM** |

## 3. Template Merge Seams (BEHAVIOR SURFACE)

### 3.1 Current Region Markers (v1)

```markdown
<!--invar:critical-->
...
<!--/invar:critical-->

<!--invar:managed version="5.0"-->
...
<!--/invar:managed-->

<!--invar:project-->
...
<!--/invar:project-->

<!--invar:user-->
...
<!--/invar:user-->
```

### 3.2 Post-DX-91 Markers (v2)

```markdown
<!--invar:begin-->
...
<!--invar:end-->
```

### 3.3 Merge Logic Changes

| Scenario | Current | Post-DX-91 |
|----------|---------|------------|
| File doesn't exist | Create | Create |
| File exists, no markers | Append | Append |
| File exists, has markers | Replace regions | Replace single region |
| User content outside markers | Preserved | Preserved |

## 5. Highest-Risk Repo Paths

### 5.1 Core Regression Fixtures (Python-only Behavior)

These paths define the simplified Python-only behavior that harness tests must validate:

| Path | Purpose | Fixture Type |
|------|---------|--------------|
| `src/invar/core/template_parser.py` | Region marker parsing | **CORE** - must adapt to single-marker |
| `src/invar/core/template_helpers.py` | Template merge logic | **CORE** - must adapt to new markers |
| `src/invar/shell/commands/init.py` | Init command | **CORE** - rewritten for v2 |
| `src/invar/shell/templates.py` | Template rendering | **CORE** - simplified |
| `src/invar/shell/template_engine.py` | Jinja2 engine | **CORE** - fewer templates |
| `src/invar/templates/manifest.toml` | Template config | **CORE** - reduced entries |

These are the integration points that validate the complete workflow:

| Entrypoint | Validates | Surface Type |
|------------|-----------|--------------|
| `invar init` (fresh) | Non-interactive v2 init | **E2E** |
| `invar init --preview` | Preview mode works | **E2E** |
| `invar init` (v1 detected) | Migration preview + confirmation | **E2E** |
| `invar dev sync` | Regenerates CLAUDE.md + INVAR.md | **E2E** |
| `invar guard` | Python-only verification | **E2E** |
| MCP `invar_guard` | Contract verification | **E2E** |

| `src/invar/core/contracts.py` | @pre/@post unchanged |
| `runtime/src/invar_runtime/` | Runtime package unchanged |
| `src/invar/shell/doc_tools.py` | Doc tools unchanged |
| `src/invar/mcp/handlers.py` | MCP tools unchanged (Python-only) |

## 9. Discovered Issues

### Issue 1: Marker Parsing Compatibility

**Location:** `src/invar/core/template_parser.py:76-77`

**Problem:** Current parser uses four region patterns (`critical`, `managed`, `project`, `user`). DX-91 introduces single marker (`begin`/`end`). Parser needs update.

**Impact:** HIGH - Affects CLAUDE.md merge logic

**Recommendation:** Add new pattern support while maintaining backward compatibility for v1 detection

---

### Issue 2: Migration Detection Logic

**Location:** `src/invar/shell/commands/init.py` (detection scattered)

**Problem:** v1 detection criteria are spread across the codebase. Need centralized detection for migration preview.

**Impact:** HIGH - Affects migration preview

**Recommendation:** Create single `detect_v1_layout()` function with clear criteria

---

### Issue 3: CLI Flag Changes

**Location:** `src/invar/shell/commands/init.py:356-386`

**Problem:** Current init has `--claude`, `--pi`, `--mcp-only`, `--language` flags. DX-91 removes these.

**Impact:** MEDIUM - Breaking change for existing scripts

**Recommendation:** Document migration path for users with scripted init
